guard/30384.htm.text: Guard Lynch: Hello, traveler. Are you planning to go to Gludio Castle Town that lies before the lord s castle? If you are, take the road here in front of me, and follow it northwest. However, you must be extra careful when you pass the Abandoned Camp.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30384-1.htm.text: Guard Lynch: Originally, it was a camp set up by the troops of Gracia. It was abandoned for some time after Gracia lost the war and withdrew their troops.
